title: IFX I2-A: installed Web UI hands-on record for V4 Guards 1.1.6 + ifx_profile 0.4.4
goal: Record the installed Web UI hands-on run (clean pass, deliberate violation blocks, UI/Host agreement, root invariance) for the exact I1 tuple and check that the composed V4 package has no V3 runtime dependency.
acceptanceCriteria: The composed receipt and package pass public verification before the session.
Clean UI Pre passes with 10 modules, non-vacuous coverage and zero findings.
Violating UI Pre blocks with IMPORT-DIRECTION from ifx-source-policy.
Installed Host queries match the UI exactly.
Base, composed installation and both Targets are unchanged.
No V3 runtime dependency in the composed package.
risks: A browser session could write into a Target or the installation.
UI results could be taken without Host cross-check.
decisions: Reuse the S7 Git-backed Targets read-only; new State and Evidence roots.
Launch only the installed receipted Web Companion.
